gaps.sentence: They agreed ___ the fence between the two gardens.
gaps.explanation: agree takes the to-infinitive: agreed to mend.

gaps.sentence: I'm sorry for ___ so long to reply.
The hotel offered ___ our room free of charge.
gaps.explanation: offer takes the to-infinitive: offered to upgrade.

gaps.sentence: I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.

gaps.sentence: He apologized for ___ so abrupt in the meeting.
I tried ___ the shelf up, but it was too heavy.
gaps.explanation: try + to-infinitive = attempt, make an effort.

gaps.sentence: They don't allow ___ in the museum.
gaps.hint: allow + noun / allow sb to do
gaps.explanation: allow + noun/-ing (no personal object): they don't allow photography. With a person: allow visitors to photograph.
